newsitem.title: USA: Call for more shareholder say in contributions.
newsitem.headline: Call for more shareholder say in contributions.

text.p: Ohio Republican Rep. Paul Gillmor said Friday he wants shareholders to have more say in deciding who receives philanthropic contributions from companies.
Gillmor introduced legislation that would also require corporations to disclose all information regarding contributions to charitable organizations.
"The main purpose of this legislation is to afford the opportunity for shareholders to review their companies' philanthropic activities," Gillmor said in a statement.
Requiring disclosure of charitable contributions would make corporations accountable to the shareholders, he said.
The congressman said he is considering adding an amendment on the subject to the Securities and Exchange Commission re-authorization bill now before Congress.
